headline: BAGIC and BALIC delivered strong growth but missed some guidance targets, while BFL showed resilience in NII and AUM growth.

segments.BAGIC: Despite missing some guidance targets for combined ratio and expense ratio, BAGIC maintained a healthy GWP growth of 9% and saw an increase in PAT by 5%. The company's focus on profitable commercial lines contributed positively to the results.
segments.BALIC: BALIC reported strong VNB growth of 39%, with NBM expanding by 4.2%. However, AUM guidance was not met, remaining unchanged from the previous quarter.
segments.BFL: BFL showed resilience in net interest income (NII) and AUM growth, both up by 22% and 24% respectively. Gross non-performing asset (GNPA) continued to be amongst the lowest in the industry at 1.03%. PAT grew by 22%, driven by higher NII.
segments.Consolidated: The consolidated revenue grew by 11% to INR 37,400 crores, while PAT increased by 8% to INR 2,244 crores. Excluding MTM movements from insurance subsidiaries, the growth would be a healthy 12%. BAGIC and BALIC solvency ratios remain strong at 339% and 346%, respectively.

keyThemes: Sustainable growth in core business lines
Resilience in NII and AUM for BFL
Strong profitability metrics despite market constraints
